integrity: Proof reconstructed from exact derangement recurrence and Jacobi matrix; finite exact checks support but do not replace the global argument. No independent certification or priority guarantee.
limitations: The claimed contribution is the conditional monotone-likelihood-ratio comparison, not known enumeration or real-rootedness. A stronger general total-positivity theorem may subsume it; Brenti 1995 full text was not available. The finding has had no independent audit.
title: Likelihood-ratio ordering of fixed points by cycle count in uniform permutations
